item.title: Footpath in immediate danger of collapse, 12th September
item.description:
A building had been erected with what appears to be CFA piles adjacent to the public footpath. It appears the footpath integrity has been compromised by the excavation for these works The permanent and temporary works do not have appear to have the normally required 3rd party checks or highways approval or they would not have been able to progress. It is also a major failing under CDM requirements of planning the project and security boundary and I will also be informing the HSE.
